  # side of it. The mean is kept alongside, for reading only.
  .pmin  <- tapply(stems$straight_score, stems$pair_row, function(v) min(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  .pmean <- tapply(stems$straight_score, stems$pair_row, function(v) mean(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  gp$pair_score      <- NA_real_
  gp$pair_score_mean <- NA_real_
  gp$pair_score[as.integer(names(.pmin))]       <- as.numeric(.pmin)
  gp$pair_score_mean[as.integer(names(.pmean))] <- as.numeric(.pmean)
  gp$pair_score[!is.finite(gp$pair_score)]           <- 0
  gp$pair_score_mean[!is.finite(gp$pair_score_mean)] <- 0

  # Per-stem status for plotting: a stem can be individually straight yet
  # still excluded, if its partner in the pair is not - the pair (and so
  # every stem in it) only survives when BOTH sides pass.
  stems$pair_straight <- gp$straight[stems$pair_row]
  stems$status <- ifelse(!stems$straight, "not_straight",
                   ifelse(stems$pair_straight, "kept", "removed_by_partner"))

  list(L = L, gp = gp, stems = stems, n_blocks = n_blocks, min_n_block = min_n_block,
       n_A = sum(gp$group %in% "A"), n_B = sum(gp$group %in% "B"),
       n_straight_stems = sum(stems$straight),
       n_straight_pairs = sum(gp$straight),
       n_scored  = sum(!is.na(stems$score_cm)),
       n_ok_curv = sum(stems$ok_curv), n_ok_sag = sum(stems$ok_sag),
       n_ok_bend = sum(stems$ok_bend),
       med_rms   = suppressWarnings(median(stems$rms_cm,   na.rm = TRUE)),
       med_curv  = suppressWarnings(median(stems$score_cm, na.rm = TRUE)),
       med_noise = suppressWarnings(median(stems$noise_cm, na.rm = TRUE)),
       med_bend  = suppressWarnings(median(stems$bend_adj_deg, na.rm = TRUE)),
       med_bfl   = suppressWarnings(median(stems$bend_floor_deg, na.rm = TRUE)),
       n_trust   = sum(stems$bend_trust, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# ── Ladder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n\u2500\u2500 Gold-length straightness gate \u2500\u2500\n")
.kv("stems",   "%s | %d stem(s), mean kept span %.2f m",
    .gold_stage, nrow(g_spans), mean(g_spans$span))
.kv("fit",     "%s, refitted inside every window | seed %d",
    toupper(gold_fit_method), gold_seed)
.kv("windows", "%d sub-window(s) x >= %d centre(s) = %d centre floor | group-B window: %s",
    gold_n_blocks, gold_min_n_block, gold_n_blocks * gold_min_n_block, groupB_window)
.kv("gate",    "%d of %d votes needed | tests: %s",
    gate_min_votes, length(gate_tests), paste(gate_tests, collapse = ", "))
.kv("",        "curv <= clamp(%.2f x noise_cm, %.2f, %.2f) cm, group-B as L^%.2f",
    curv_noise_mult, curv_thresh_cm, curv_thresh_max, .exp_or(gold_exp_curv))
.kv("",        "sag  <= clamp(%.2f x sag_floor, %.2f, %.2f) cm, group-B as L^%.2f",
    sag_noise_mult, sag_thresh_cm, sag_thresh_max, .exp_or(gold_exp_sag))
.kv("",        "bend <= clamp(%.2f x bend_floor, %.2f, %.2f) deg, group-B as L^%.2f",
    bend_noise_mult, bend_thresh_deg, bend_thresh_max, .exp_or(gold_exp_bend))
.kv("bend",    "end to end: base sub-window against top | one of the %d votes",
    length(gate_tests))
.kv("",        "trusted when the %.1f/%.1f m ratio is in [%.2f, %.2f] - expected %.2f, tolerance x%.2f - AND bend/(kappa*lever) <= %.2f",
    bend_ref_long, bend_ref_short, bend_scale_min, bend_scale_max,
    bend_scale_expected, bend_scale_tol, bend_pred_tol)

# ── Single evaluation at the gold length ───────────────────────────────────────
gold_res <- .gold_eval(gold_length)
if (is.null(gold_res)) stop("Gold-length evaluation produced no usable pairs.")

gold_stems <- gold_res$stems
gold_pairs <- gold_res$gp
gold_n_use <- if (identical(gold_count_basis, "pairs")) gold_res$n_straight_pairs else
                                                          gold_res$n_straight_stems

cat(sprintf("  %.1f m   group A %d, group B %d | straight: %d stem(s), %d pair(s)\n",
            gold_res$L, gold_res$n_A, gold_res$n_B,
            gold_res$n_straight_stems, gold_res$n_straight_pairs))
cat(sprintf("               median curv %.3f cm (noise %.3f) | median bend %.2f deg (floor %.2f)\n",
            gold_res$med_curv, gold_res$med_noise, gold_res$med_bend, gold_res$med_bfl))
cat(sprintf("               votes passed: curv %d | sag %d | bend %d  of %d stem-window(s)\n",
            gold_res$n_ok_curv, gold_res$n_ok_sag, gold_res$n_ok_bend, nrow(gold_res$stems)))

gold_trace <- data.frame(
  gold_length = gold_res$L, n_A = gold_res$n_A, n_B = gold_res$n_B,
  n_straight_stems = gold_res$n_straight_stems,
  n_straight_pairs = gold_res$n_straight_pairs,
  n_scored = gold_res$n_scored,
  median_bend_deg   = round(gold_res$med_bend, 3),
  median_bfloor_deg = round(gold_res$med_bfl, 3),
  median_curv_cm    = round(gold_res$med_curv,  3),
  median_noise_cm   = round(gold_res$med_noise, 3),
  median_rms_cm     = round(gold_res$med_rms,   3),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\nGold length = %.1f m | %d straight %s\n",
            gold_length, gold_n_use,
            if (identical(gold_count_basis, "pairs")) "pair(s)" else "stem(s)"))

# ── Critical shortfall: assume a short/crooked forest, fall back to silver ────
# Too few straight units at the gold length is a data problem, not a tuning
# one - but rather than fail the run, assume either that very few stems here
# are genuinely straight, or that the forest is largely short trees the 8 m
# window can never reach, and produce weighting-only scores at a shorter
# length instead. `gold_gate_active` records which branch ran: when it stays
# TRUE, `gold_stems$straight` / `gold_pairs$straight` (set above by
# .gold_eval) are the real filter and everything below reads them as such.
# When it drops to FALSE, this chunk does NOT filter on straightness at all -
# every usable pair is passed straight through, and the scores that follow
# exist only to feed the weighting step in 2.3.
gold_gate_active <- TRUE

if (gold_n_use < gold_crit_straight) {

  gold_gate_active <- FALSE
  cat(sprintf("\n*** Only %d straight %s at %.1f m, below %d. ***\n",
              gold_n_use,
              if (identical(gold_count_basis, "pairs")) "pair(s)" else "stem(s)",
              gold_length, gold_crit_straight))
  cat("*** Assuming too few very-straight stems, or a largely short-tree forest. ***\n")
  cat(sprintf("*** Falling back to a %.1f m silver-length pass, for WEIGHTING ONLY - no pair is filtered on straightness this run. ***\n",
              silver_length))
  warning(sprintf("Gold-length gate: only %d straight unit(s) at %.1f m - below the critical minimum of %d. Falling back to a %.1f m weighting-only silver pass.",
                  gold_n_use, gold_length, gold_crit_straight, silver_length), call. = FALSE)

  # ---- Step 1: the population that already passed 2.1.1 and 2.1.2 ----------
  # This is exactly g_by_stem / .pair_ids - nothing to rebuild for the normal
  # case, since those chunks already fed this one.
  silver_spans <- g_spans[g_spans$span >= silver_length, , drop = FALSE]

  # ---- Step 2: too few stems even reach silver_length -----------------------
  # Rerun the 2.1.1 absolute gates at half the usual span, directly against the
  # Stage-1 fate objects (not the pre-filtered `_pre` ones - the whole point is
  # to recover stems 2.1.1 removed on span). The stem-level MAD filter (2.1.2)
  # is NOT rerun: it scores density, not span, and re-running it here would
  # mean re-deriving a median/MAD over a different population than 2.1.2 used,
  # which is a second filter decision this fallback has no business making.
  if (nrow(silver_spans) < silver_min_stems) {

    cat(sprintf("*** Fewer than %d stem(s) reach %.1f m - re-running the stem pre-filter at %.1f m span. ***\n",
                silver_min_stems, silver_length, prefilter_min_span / 2))

    .half_fs_1 <- if (exists("slice_fate_summary_1")) slice_fate_summary_1 else NULL
    .half_fs_2 <- if (exists("slice_fate_summary_2")) slice_fate_summary_2 else NULL
    .half_sf_1 <- if (exists("slice_fates_1"))        slice_fates_1        else NULL
    .half_sf_2 <- if (exists("slice_fates_2"))        slice_fates_2        else NULL

    .half_pre_1 <- .pre_table(.half_fs_1, .half_sf_1, "las_1")
    .half_pre_2 <- .pre_table(.half_fs_2, .half_sf_2, "las_2")

    # prefilter_min_span is reassigned only for the duration of this call -
    # .apply_gates reads it (and prefilter_min_kept) as globals - then
    # restored immediately, so nothing downstream of this chunk is affected.
    .orig_min_span     <- prefilter_min_span
    prefilter_min_span <- prefilter_min_span / 2
    .half_pre_1 <- .apply_gates(.half_pre_1)
    .half_pre_2 <- .apply_gates(.half_pre_2)
    prefilter_min_span <- .orig_min_span

    .half_kept_1 <- if (is.null(.half_pre_1)) character(0) else .half_pre_1$TreeID[!.half_pre_1$fail_self]
    .half_kept_2 <- if (is.null(.half_pre_2)) character(0) else .half_pre_2$TreeID[!.half_pre_2$fail_self]

    # Rebuild a g_src-shaped kept-centre table for whichever stems this wider
    # gate recovers, and fold it into g_by_stem / g_spans / .pair_ids so the
    # silver scoring pass below sees the expanded population. Stems already in
    # g_by_stem are left untouched - this only ADDS the newly-recovered ones.
    .half_s1 <- if (exists("slice_fates_1")) slice_fates_1 else NULL
    .half_s2 <- if (exists("slice_fates_2")) slice_fates_2 else NULL
    .half_sub <- function(d, ids, ep) {
      if (is.null(d) || length(ids) == 0L) return(NULL)
      d <- d[as.character(d$TreeID) %in% ids &
             d$status == "kept" & !is.na(d$center_x) &
             !is.na(d$center_y) & !is.na(d$slice_z), , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(d) == 0L) return(NULL)
      d$epoch <- ep
      d
    }
    .half_new_1 <- .half_sub(.half_s1, setdiff(.half_kept_1, g_spans$TreeID[g_spans$epoch == "las_1"]), "las_1")
    .half_new_2 <- .half_sub(.half_s2, setdiff(.half_kept_2, g_spans$TreeID[g_spans$epoch == "las_2"]), "las_2")
    .half_new   <- rbind(.half_new_1, .half_new_2)

    if (!is.null(.half_new) && nrow(.half_new) > 0L) {
      .half_new$stem_key <- paste(.half_new$epoch, .half_new$TreeID, sep = "|")
      .half_new_by_stem   <- split(.half_new, .half_new$stem_key)
      g_by_stem <- c(g_by_stem, .half_new_by_stem)
      g_spans <- rbind(g_spans, do.call(rbind, lapply(.half_new_by_stem, function(d) data.frame(
        epoch = d$epoch[1], TreeID = d$TreeID[1], stem_key = d$stem_key[1],
        z_lo = min(d$slice_z), z_hi = max(d$slice_z),
        span = diff(range(d$slice_z)), n_kept = nrow(d), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))))
      rownames(g_spans) <- NULL
      cat(sprintf("    recovered %d additional stem(s) (las_1 %d, las_2 %d)\n",
                  length(.half_new_by_stem),
                  sum(vapply(.half_new_by_stem, function(d) d$epoch[1] == "las_1", logical(1))),
                  sum(vapply(.half_new_by_stem, function(d) d$epoch[1] == "las_2", logical(1)))))
    } else {
      cat("    no additional stems recovered at the halved span.\n")
    }

    silver_spans <- g_spans[g_spans$span >= silver_length, , drop = FALSE]

    # Pairs may now include stems absent from the original .pair_ids universe
    # (a stem the gold-length population never carried). Rebuild it from
    # pairs_stage1 restricted to stems present in the (now expanded) g_spans.
    .pair_ids <- data.frame(
      TreeID_1 = as.character(pairs_stage1$TreeID_1),
      TreeID_2 = as.character(pairs_stage1$TreeID_2), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    .pair_ids <- .pair_ids[.pair_ids$TreeID_1 %in% g_spans$TreeID[g_spans$epoch == "las_1"] &
                            .pair_ids$TreeID_2 %in% g_spans$TreeID[g_spans$epoch == "las_2"], , drop = FALSE]
    .s1_all <- .span_of(.pair_ids$TreeID_1, "las_1")
    .s2_all <- .span_of(.pair_ids$TreeID_2, "las_2")
  }

  # ---- Step 3: score every silver-eligible stem at silver_length -----------
  # Reuses .gold_eval's group/threshold/vote machinery so the score columns
  # (curv_cm, sag_cm, bend_adj_deg, noise_cm, ...) that 2.3's weighting reads
  # come out in exactly the same shape gold_stems normally has. Every stem
  # here already has span >= silver_length by construction (Step 2), so every
  # pair lands in group A - there is no group B at the silver length.
  silver_res <- .gold_eval(silver_length, n_blocks = silver_n_blocks,
                            min_n_block = silver_min_n_block)
  if (is.null(silver_res))
    stop("Silver-length fallback produced no usable pairs either - check the stem population.")

  cat(sprintf("\nSilver length = %.1f m | %d stem(s) scored (weighting only)\n",
              silver_length, nrow(silver_res$stems)))
  cat(sprintf("               median curv %.3f cm (noise %.3f) | median bend %.2f deg (floor %.2f)\n",
              silver_res$med_curv, silver_res$med_noise, silver_res$med_bend, silver_res$med_bfl))

  # ---- Step 4: no filtering - every usable pair passes through -------------
  # The vote/threshold columns computed above are left in gold_stems /
  # gold_pairs as reported diagnostics (so a reader can still see which
  # stems would have passed a straightness vote at the silver length), but
  # `straight` is forced TRUE for every usable pair: this run does not trust
  # the vote enough to filter on it, only enough to weight on it.
  silver_res$stems$straight <- TRUE
  silver_res$gp$straight    <- silver_res$gp$usable

  gold_stems <- silver_res$stems
  gold_pairs <- silver_res$gp
  gold_n_use <- if (identical(gold_count_basis, "pairs")) sum(gold_pairs$straight, na.rm = TRUE) else
                                                            sum(gold_stems$straight, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ── Threshold calibration aid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# RANSAC centre precision sets a floor no stem can score below however straight
# it is. Under the old rms gate that floor had to be guessed; noise_cm now
# MEASURES it per stem, so the honest calibration is to set curv_thresh_cm
# above the noise_cm distribution rather than against rms_cm. A curvature
# threshold below the noise floor sends every rung to zero and forces the
# cascade to the bottom.
.qa <- gold_stems[gold_stems$group == "A" & !is.na(gold_stems$curv_cm), ]
if (nrow(.qa) > 0L) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\u2500\u2500 Group-A scores over the bottom %.2f m (n = %d) \u2500\u2500\n",
              gold_length, nrow(.qa)))
  .qhead()
  .pq("curv_cm",     .qa$curv_cm)
  .pq("thr_curv",    .qa$thresh_curv)
  .pq("sag_cm",      .qa$sag_cm)
  .pq("thr_sag",     .qa$thresh_sag)
  .pq("bend_adj",    .qa$bend_adj_deg)
  .pq("thr_bend",    .qa$thresh_bend)
  .pq("noise_cm",    .qa$noise_cm)
  .pq("sag_floor",   .qa$sag_floor_cm)
  .pq("bend_floor",  .qa$bend_floor_deg)
  .pq("curv_dir_cm", .qa$curv_dir_cm)
  .pq("sbend_cm",    .qa$sbend_cm)
  .pq("rms_cm",      .qa$rms_cm)
  .pq("bend_ratio",  .qa$bend_ratio)
  .pq("bend_pred_f", .qa$bend_pred_f)

  # Which tests carry the vote, and how often they disagree. A test that
  # passes almost nobody or almost everybody is not voting, it is a constant -
  # and two tests that never disagree are one test counted twice.
  cat("\n  votes      ")
  print(table(factor(.qa$votes, levels = 0:length(gate_tests))))
  cat(sprintf("  passed     curv %d | sag %d | bend %d  of %d | unanimous %d, split %d\n",
              sum(.qa$ok_curv), sum(.qa$ok_sag), sum(.qa$ok_bend), nrow(.qa),
              sum(.qa$votes %in% c(0L, length(gate_tests))),
              sum(!.qa$votes %in% c(0L, length(gate_tests)))))
  cat(sprintf("  swing      %d stem(s) kept that curv alone would fail | %d failed that curv alone would keep\n",
              sum(.qa$straight & !.qa$ok_curv), sum(!.qa$straight & .qa$ok_curv)))

  # Reported, not acted on. The first number says how much of the departure
  # is a single arc; the second says whether the two estimators - four block
  # medians against a quadratic through every centre - agree about the size of
  # it. Persistent disagreement is a reason to look, not a reason to fail.
  cat(sprintf("\n  shape      %d of %d are mostly one arc (curv_dir_cm > sbend_cm) | sag_cm / curv_cm %.2f at the median\n",
              sum(.qa$curv_dir_cm > .qa$sbend_cm, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(.qa),
              suppressWarnings(median(ifelse(.qa$curv_cm > 1e-9,
                                             .qa$sag_cm / .qa$curv_cm, NA_real_),
                                      na.rm = TRUE))))
  cat(sprintf("  threshold  %d on the floor (%.2f cm), %d scaled by their own noise, %d on the ceiling (%.2f cm)\n",
              sum(.qa$curv_base <= curv_thresh_cm + 1e-9, na.rm = TRUE), curv_thresh_cm,
              sum(.qa$curv_base > curv_thresh_cm + 1e-9 &
                  .qa$curv_base < curv_thresh_max - 1e-9, na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(.qa$curv_base >= curv_thresh_max - 1e-9, na.rm = TRUE), curv_thresh_max))
  # The negative result, stated numerically so it can be quoted rather than
  # asserted: this is why bend_deg is not part of the verdict.
  cat(sprintf("  bend       %d within their own floor (bend_adj = 0) | trusted on %d (%.0f%%): %d fail the scale band, %d fail the kappa check\n",
              sum(.qa$bend_adj_deg <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(.qa$bend_trust, na.rm = TRUE),
              100 * sum(.qa$bend_trust, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(.qa),
              sum(is.na(.qa$bend_ratio) | .qa$bend_ratio < bend_scale_min |
                  .qa$bend_ratio > bend_scale_max),
              sum(is.na(.qa$bend_pred_f) | .qa$bend_pred_f > bend_pred_tol)))
  cat(sprintf("             measured length exponent %.2f against 1.00 for a real bend - it does not accumulate along the stem, so it does not gate\n",
              gold_exp_bend))
}
.qb <- gold_stems[gold_stems$group == "B" & !is.na(gold_stems$curv_cm), ]
if (nrow(.qb) > 0L)
  cat(sprintf("\nGroup-B (n = %d): windows %.2f - %.2f m | thresholds %.4f - %.4f cm, scaled as L^%.2f\n",
              nrow(.qb), min(.qb$win_len), max(.qb$win_len),
              min(.qb$thresh_curv), max(.qb$thresh_curv), gold_scale_exp))

# ── Unscored windows and failure reasons ──────────────────────────────────────
.nsp  <- sum(!is.na(gold_stems$blk_min) & gold_stems$blk_min < gold_min_n_block)
.nwin <- sum(is.na(gold_stems$curv_cm)) - .nsp
.fw   <- table(gold_stems$fail_why[nzchar(gold_stems$fail_why)])
if (.nsp > 0L || .nwin > 0L || length(.fw) > 0L) {
  cat("\n\u2500\u2500 Unscored windows and failures \u2500\u2500\n")
  if (.nsp > 0L) {
    .sp  <- gold_stems[!is.na(gold_stems$blk_min) &
                       gold_stems$blk_min < gold_min_n_block, , drop = FALSE]
    .tb  <- table(.sp$blk_min)
    # A stem with plenty of centres overall but a starved block has a vertical
    # gap, not a thin cloud - worth separating, because the two have different
    # causes upstream.
    .gap <- sum(.sp$n_win >= gold_n_blocks * gold_min_n_block, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat(sprintf("  %d dropped on sub-window coverage (a block held fewer than %d centres)\n",
                .nsp, gold_min_n_block))
    cat(sprintf("    emptiest block: %s\n",
                paste(sprintf("%s centre(s) x%d", names(.tb), as.integer(.tb)),
                      collapse = ", ")))
    cat(sprintf("    windows %.2f - %.2f m | n_win %d - %d | %d of them held enough centres overall (>= %d) but unevenly - a vertical gap, not a sparse stem\n",
                min(.sp$win_len, na.rm = TRUE), max(.sp$win_len, na.rm = TRUE),
                min(.sp$n_win), max(.sp$n_win), .gap,
                gold_n_blocks * gold_min_n_block))
  }
  if (.nwin > 0L)
    cat(sprintf("  %d further window(s) unscored: fewer than %d centres, a degenerate z range, or a failed line fit\n",
                .nwin, gold_n_blocks * gold_min_n_block))
  if (length(.fw) > 0L)
    cat(sprintf("  reasons: %s\n",
                paste(sprintf("%s %d", names(.fw), as.integer(.fw)), collapse = " | ")))
}

# ── Surviving pairs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pairs_gold_A <- .pairs_g[which(gold_pairs$group %in% "A" & gold_pairs$straight), , drop = FALSE]
pairs_gold_B <- .pairs_g[which(gold_pairs$group %in% "B" & gold_pairs$straight), , drop = FALSE]
pairs_gold   <- .pairs_g[which(gold_pairs$straight), , drop = FALSE]

stems_gold_1 <- gold_stems$TreeID[gold_stems$epoch == "las_1" & gold_stems$straight]
stems_gold_2 <- gold_stems$TreeID[gold_stems$epoch == "las_2" & gold_stems$straight]

cat("\n\u2500\u2500 Result \u2500\u2500\n")
cat(sprintf("  straight pairs  group A %d of %d | group B %d of %d | total %d of %d usable\n",
            nrow(pairs_gold_A), gold_res$n_A, nrow(pairs_gold_B), gold_res$n_B,
            nrow(pairs_gold), sum(gold_pairs$usable)))
cat(sprintf("  straight stems  las_1 %d | las_2 %d\n",
            length(stems_gold_1), length(stems_gold_2)))

# ── Ranking, and the candidate set for the Stage 3 Z-translation ─────────────
# Every usable pair is ranked on pair_score, whether or not it passed the vote.
# Nothing is selected here beyond recording the order and naming the top-up
# candidates: the final Z-translation pair set cannot be assembled until 2.3 has
# run its IRLS residual filter, so it is built in Step 2.4.
#
# Three regimes, and which set each hands to which solve:
#
#   n_gate >= ztrans_target_pairs
#       "gate". Both solves use the gate survivors. Nothing is topped up.
#
#   gold_crit_straight <= n_gate < ztrans_target_pairs
#       "topup". The ROTATION still uses only the gate survivors - a rotation
#       solved from bent stems is a wrong rotation, and the vote is the only
#       thing standing between it and them. The Z-TRANSLATION is topped up to
#       ztrans_target_pairs with the best-ranked pairs that failed the vote,
#       because its error falls with pair count and a mildly bent stem still
#       carries matchable features up its length.
#
#   n_gate < gold_crit_straight
#       "irls_all". The silver fallback has already run: the gate filtered
#       nothing, every usable pair is in the rotation solve, and the only
#       selection left is the IRLS residual filter itself. The Z-translation
#       then uses exactly what survives that - see Step 2.4.
gold_pairs$rank_score <- gold_pairs$pair_score
gold_pairs$rank_score[!gold_pairs$usable] <- NA_real_

ztrans_rank <- .pairs_g
ztrans_rank$usable     <- gold_pairs$usable
ztrans_rank$group      <- gold_pairs$group
ztrans_rank$straight   <- gold_pairs$straight
ztrans_rank$pair_score <- gold_pairs$pair_score
ztrans_rank$pair_score_mean <- gold_pairs$pair_score_mean
ztrans_rank <- ztrans_rank[which(ztrans_rank$usable), , drop = FALSE]
ztrans_rank <- ztrans_rank[order(-ztrans_rank$pair_score), , drop = FALSE]
ztrans_rank$rank <- seq_len(nrow(ztrans_rank))
rownames(ztrans_rank) <- NULL

.n_gate <- nrow(pairs_gold)
ztrans_mode <- if (!gold_gate_active)                       "irls_all" else
               if (.n_gate >= ztrans_target_pairs)          "gate"     else
                                                            "topup"

# The top-up candidates, in rank order: pairs that did NOT pass the vote, taken
# best-first, only as many as are needed to reach the target. Empty in the "gate"
# and "irls_all" modes.
ztrans_topup <- ztrans_rank[0, , drop = FALSE]
if (identical(ztrans_mode, "topup")) {
  .cand <- ztrans_rank[!ztrans_rank$straight, , drop = FALSE]
  .need <- min(nrow(.cand), ztrans_target_pairs - .n_gate)
  if (.need > 0L) ztrans_topup <- .cand[seq_len(.need), , drop = FALSE]
}

cat("\n\u2500\u2500 Straightness ranking \u2500\u2500\n")
cat(sprintf("  scored %d usable pair(s) | pair_score = min(the two stems), higher = straighter\n",
            nrow(ztrans_rank)))
if (nrow(ztrans_rank) > 0L) {
  .rt <- ztrans_rank[, c("rank", "TreeID_1", "TreeID_2", "group", "straight",
                         "pair_score", "pair_score_mean")]
  .rt$pair_score      <- round(.rt$pair_score, 4)
  .rt$pair_score_mean <- round(.rt$pair_score_mean, 4)
  print(utils::head(.rt, max(ztrans_target_pairs, .n_gate) + 5L), row.names = FALSE)
  if (nrow(.rt) > max(ztrans_target_pairs, .n_gate) + 5L)
    cat(sprintf("  ... %d further pair(s) not shown\n",
                nrow(.rt) - (max(ztrans_target_pairs, .n_gate) + 5L)))
}
cat(sprintf("\n  Z-translation pair set mode: %s (%d gate survivor(s), target %d)\n",
            ztrans_mode, .n_gate, ztrans_target_pairs))

# The stem group the ROTATION solve will run on. gold_gate_active is FALSE only
# when the silver fallback fired, i.e. too few pairs cleared the 2-of-3 vote and
# every usable stem bottom was admitted instead.
.tally(irls_stem_group = if (gold_gate_active) "consensus" else "all",
       n_pairs_gate_passed = .n_gate,
       ztrans_mode = ztrans_mode)
if (identical(ztrans_mode, "topup"))
  cat(sprintf("    topping up with %d best-ranked non-passing pair(s); the rotation solve is NOT topped up\n",
              nrow(ztrans_topup)))
if (identical(ztrans_mode, "irls_all"))
  cat("    silver fallback ran - the Z-translation will use every pair the IRLS residual filter keeps\n")
rm(.n_gate)
cat(sprintf("\n  evaluation summary (%s):\n",
            if (gold_gate_active) "gold length, filtering" else "silver length, weighting only"))
print(gold_trace, row.names = FALSE)

# ── Curvature threshold sweep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# What curv_thresh_cm would have to be to yield a given number of straight
# units. Read the threshold off the stem
# distribution here rather than guessing it - but note the pair coupling: with
# count_basis = "pairs" both sides must pass, so a per-stem pass rate p gives
# roughly p^2 pairs, and a modest pair target needs a large stem fraction.
if (curv_sweep && any(!is.na(gold_stems$score_cm))) {
  # All three thresholds move TOGETHER, by one multiplier. Sweeping curv's
  # floor alone would only ever move one vote out of three, which answers a
  # question nobody is asking now that the gate is a majority. The multiplier
  # keeps the three thresholds in the fixed physical relation they were set
  # in, so each row is one consistent claim about how bent is too bent.
  .grid <- round(seq(0.5, 2.0, length.out = curv_sweep_n), 3)
  .sw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(.grid, function(f) {
    okc <- !is.na(gold_stems$curv_cm)      & gold_stems$curv_cm      <= f * gold_stems$thresh_curv
    oks <- !is.na(gold_stems$sag_cm)       & gold_stems$sag_cm       <= f * gold_stems$thresh_sag
    okb <- !is.na(gold_stems$bend_adj_deg) & gold_stems$bend_adj_deg <= f * gold_stems$thresh_bend
    vt  <- rowSums(cbind(curv = okc, sag = oks, bend = okb)[, gate_tests, drop = FALSE])
    st  <- vt >= gate_min_votes
    pr  <- tapply(st, gold_stems$pair_row, all)
    data.frame(mult = f,
               curv_cm = round(f * median(gold_stems$thresh_curv, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
               sag_cm  = round(f * median(gold_stems$thresh_sag,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
               bend_deg = round(f * median(gold_stems$thresh_bend, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
               ok_curv = sum(okc), ok_sag = sum(oks), ok_bend = sum(okb),
               straight_stems = sum(st), straight_pairs = sum(pr, na.rm = TRUE))
  }))
  cat(sprintf("\n\u2500\u2500 Threshold sweep at %.1f m%s: all three scaled together \u2500\u2500\n",
              if (gold_gate_active) gold_length else silver_length,
              if (gold_gate_active) "" else " (silver fallback, weighting only - this sweep is diagnostic, not a live gate)"))
  cat("  columns 2-4 are the MEDIAN per-stem threshold at that multiplier, not the floor\n")
  # Both sides of a pair must pass, so straight_pairs falls away far faster
  # than straight_stems. Pick the row that meets the target you actually have.
  print(.sw, row.names = FALSE)
}

# ── Worst windows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A metre-scale deviation from a stem's own fitted line inside the gold window
# is not a bend - it is a reconstruction that survived both Stage 1 cleaning
# passes and should not have. Named here so it can be chased upstream rather
# than merely rejected.
.wr <- gold_stems[!is.na(gold_stems$rms_cm), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(.wr) > 0L) {
  .wr <- .wr[order(-.wr$rms_cm), , drop = FALSE]
  .wr <- utils::head(.wr, worst_report_n)
  cat(sprintf("\n\u2500\u2500 Worst %d window(s) by deviation from the fitted line \u2500\u2500\n",
              nrow(.wr)))
  print(.wr[, c("epoch", "TreeID", "group", "n_win", "rms_cm", "curv_cm",
                "sag_cm", "bend_adj_deg", "votes", "noise_cm", "R_curv",
                "fail_why")], row.names = FALSE)
  .abs <- sum(.wr$rms_cm > 50, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (.abs > 0L)
    cat(sprintf("  %d of these exceed 50 cm - implausible for a stem axis over %.1f m, treat as Stage 1 failures.\n",
                .abs, if (gold_gate_active) gold_length else silver_length))
}

# ── Plots: each gated score against window length, with its threshold curve ──
# One panel per test rather than one combined score, because a stem can fail
# either way and the point of the split is to see WHICH.
if (gold_plot) {
  gs <- gold_stems[!is.na(gold_stems$score_cm), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(gs) > 0L) {

    # The bias correction clips at zero, and a perfectly straight stem SHOULD
    # land there - but log(0) would silently drop exactly the stems the gate
    # passes. Floor the display copies so they sit on the axis instead.
    .flr <- 1e-3
    gs$curv_p  <- pmax(gs$score_cm, .flr)
    gs$noise_p <- pmax(gs$noise_cm, .flr)
    gs$bend_p  <- pmax(gs$bend_adj_deg,   1e-4)
    gs$bendr_p <- pmax(gs$bend_deg,       1e-4)
    gs$bendf_p <- pmax(gs$bend_floor_deg, 1e-4)

    cl <- seq(min(c(gs$win_len, gold_length)), max(c(gs$win_len, gold_length)),
              length.out = 200)
    .curve <- function(t0, p) data.frame(
      win_len = cl,
      thresh  = ifelse(cl >= gold_length, t0, t0 * (cl / gold_length)^p))

    .panel <- function(ycol, t0, p, ylab, ttl, sub) {
      ggplot(gs, aes(win_len, .data[[ycol]])) +
        geom_line(data = .curve(t0, p), aes(win_len, thresh), colour = "#D7263D",
                  linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = gold_length, colour = "grey55",
                   linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
        geom_point(aes(colour = group, shape = status), size = 2.1,
                   stroke = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(A = "#2C7FB8", B = "#F07C10"), name = "group") +
        scale_shape_manual(
          values = c(kept = 16, removed_by_partner = 1, not_straight = 4),
          labels = c(kept = "kept", removed_by_partner = "removed (partner failed)",
                     not_straight = "not straight"),
          name = "status") +
        scale_y_log10() +
        labs(title = ttl, subtitle = sub, x = "Window length (m)", y = ylab) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
        theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    }

    print(.panel("curv_p", curv_thresh_cm, gold_scale_exp,
                 "score_cm (log scale)",
                 "Curvature score (curv_cm) against window length",
                 sprintf("gold %.2f m | noise removed by the within-block split | zero curvature floored to %.3f cm for display | dashed = threshold, (L/gold)^%.2f below gold (measured exponent)",
                         gold_length, .flr, gold_scale_exp)))

    # Observed bend against what the quadratic's curvature predicts. Two
    # independent estimates of the same geometry: agreement puts points on the
    # 1:1 line, and a cloud far above it means bend_deg is reading something
    # the residuals do not contain.
    gs$bendp_p <- pmax(gs$bend_pred_deg, 1e-4)
    p_pred <- ggplot(gs, aes(bendp_p, bendr_p)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey55",
                  linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(aes(colour = group, shape = status), size = 2.1,
                 stroke = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(A = "#2C7FB8", B = "#F07C10"), name = "group") +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c(kept = 16, removed_by_partner = 1, not_straight = 4),
        labels = c(kept = "kept", removed_by_partner = "removed (partner failed)",
                   not_straight = "not straight"),
        name = "status") +
      scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
      labs(title = "Observed bend against the bend the fitted curvature predicts",
           subtitle = "dotted = 1:1 | x axis is kappa x the base-to-top lever from the quadratic fit | agreement means bend_deg is reading real geometry",
           x = "bend_pred_deg (log scale)", y = "bend_deg (log scale)") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    print(p_pred)

    # Raw bend against the floor it was separated from - the bend counterpart
    # of the curvature plot below. A cloud hugging the 1:1 line means the
    # sub-windows are too short to resolve direction, not that the stems are
    # straight.
    p_bsplit <- ggplot(gs, aes(bendf_p, bendr_p)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey55",
                  linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(aes(colour = group, shape = status), size = 2.1,
                 stroke = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(A = "#2C7FB8", B = "#F07C10"), name = "group") +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c(kept = 16, removed_by_partner = 1, not_straight = 4),
        labels = c(kept = "kept", removed_by_partner = "removed (partner failed)",
                   not_straight = "not straight"),
        name = "status") +
      scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
      labs(title = "Raw base-to-top bend against its simulated noise floor",
           subtitle = "dotted = 1:1 | points on it have no direction change beyond the slope error of the two end sub-windows",
           x = "bend_floor_deg (log scale)", y = "bend_deg (log scale)") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    print(p_bsplit)

    # Curvature against the noise floor it was separated from. Points near the
    # 1:1 line are stems whose deviation is entirely explained by centre error;
    # the gate is only meaningful for points well above it.
    p_split <- ggplot(gs, aes(noise_p, curv_p)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey55",
                  linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(aes(colour = group, shape = status), size = 2.1,
                 stroke = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(A = "#2C7FB8", B = "#F07C10"), name = "group") +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c(kept = 16, removed_by_partner = 1, not_straight = 4),
        labels = c(kept = "kept", removed_by_partner = "removed (partner failed)",
                   not_straight = "not straight"),
        name = "status") +
      scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
      labs(title = "Gated deviation against the noise floor it was separated from",
           subtitle = "dotted = 1:1 | points on or below it have no deviation beyond RANSAC centre error",
           x = "noise_cm (log scale)", y = "score_cm (log scale)") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    print(p_split)
  }
}

# ── Parameter record ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gl <- list(
